summary: Frontend-only e2e test of YNNCK portfolio rebuild (desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Tested hero, intro cards, header nav + scroll progress, 4 project cards -> /work/:slug (client-side, verified no full reload), detail page (image, facts, body, mailto, back link to /#work, 3 more-cards, document.title), header/footer nav from detail page back to home sections, unknown slug redirect, skills, CV timeline (9 items, first 4 Current, fill scaleY 0.44 -> 0.80 on scroll), full CV link, highlights, contact mailto + 3 steps, footer content/links/back-to-top, reveal animations (0 hidden elements after scroll), mobile stacking/no horizontal overflow. All features pass; no console/page errors, no broken images.

issues: Nav links Experiences/What I do/CV are hidden on mobile with no menu alternative; only logo + 'Let's talk' remain. Likely mirrors original design - confirm intended.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js catch-all route '*' renders Home without changing URL (e.g. /foo shows home at /foo); consider <Navigate to='/' replace/> for consistency with unknown /work/:slug behaviour.
Navigation to a far section from a detail page (e.g. Let's talk -> /#contact) relies on smooth scroll taking ~1.5s; works correctly, just note for test timing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend-only site. Smooth scrolling: wait >=2s after nav clicks before asserting section positions. Reveal uses .rv/.in classes via IntersectionObserver; scroll through the page in 400-500px steps then wait ~1.5s before checking opacity.
